title: State of the climate: 2026 likely to tie with 2024 as the warmest year on record - Carbon Brief
gist: Carbon Brief gives 2026 a 67% chance of beating 2024 as the warmest year on record (best estimate 1.52C), with datasets likely split in January, as a record-breaking El Niño heads for a ~4C peak in December. It projects 2027 at ~1.74C with a 96% chance of a new record, while Earth's energy imbalance has risen 2.4-fold since the 2000s, signalling accelerating warming.
